identificationModule.briefTitle: SYS6010 Combined With Enlonstobart Versus Immunotherapy+ Platinum-based Chemotherapy for Patients With PD-L1-Positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic NSCLC（SYNSTAR 04）
identificationModule.officialTitle: An Open-label, Multicenter Randomized Phase III Study of SYS6010 Combined With Enlonstobart Versus Immunotherapy+ Platinum-based Chemotherapy as First-Line Treatment for Patients With PD-L1-Positive Locally Advanced or Metastatic NSCLC

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study was an open-label, multi-center, randomized phase III study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of SYS6010 combined with Enlonstobart versus Immunotherapy+ Platinum-based chemotherapy as First-Line treatment for patients with PD-L1-Positive locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Avoid duplicating information that will be entered elsewhere, such as Eligibility Criteria or Outcome Measures.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: The patients will be randomized in a 1:1 ratio to SYS6010 combined with Enlonstobart or Tislelizumab+Platinum-based chemotherapy

armGroups.label: SYS6010 combined with Enlonstobart group
armGroups.description: SYS6010 injection and Enlonstobart injection will be administrated on a 21-day cycle.

armGroups.label: Tislelizumab+ Platinum-based chemotherapy
armGroups.description: For squamous NSCLC, Tislelizumab +Paclitaxel+Carboplatin were recommended to be administrated on a 21-day cycle. For nonsquamous NSCLC, Tislelizumab + Pemetrexed + Cisplatin or Carboplatin were recommended to be administrated on a 21-day cycle.

interventions.name: SYS6010 injection
interventions.description: SYS6010 is Lyophilized powder for injection as an EGFR-ADC. SYS6010 will be administered via intravenous infusion, Q3W, with 21 days as one treatment cycle, at a dose of 4.5 mg/kg.

interventions.name: Enlonstobart injection
interventions.description: Enlonstobart is arecombinant human anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody injection，and will be administered by intravenous infusion, Q3W, with 21 days as one treatment cycle at a dosage of 360 mg.

interventions.name: Tislelizumab injection
interventions.description: Tislelizumab is a marketed recombinant human anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody injection, and will be administered by intravenous infusion, Q3W, with 21 days as one treatment cycle at a dosage of 200 mg.

interventions.name: Paclitaxel+Carboplatin or Pemetrexed + Cisplatin/Carboplatin
interventions.description:
Paclitaxel+Carboplatin or Pemetrexed + Cisplatin/Carboplatin are widely accepted and common chemotherapy medication.

For squamous NSCLC, Paclitaxel+Carboplatin were recommended to be administrated on a 21-day cycle. For nonsquamous NSCLC, Pemetrexed + Cisplatin or Carboplatin were recommended to be administrated on a 21-day cycle.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Progression Free Survival (PFS) assessed by IRC
